answer: For 1,000 fakes, the bill starts before any earning: every new vertex begins at the foot of the mesa, with zero trust, and climbs only by completing work that distinct established agents verify and vouch for. A sybil clique can vouch for itself, but a yarrow cut test measures how many independent paths connect it to the honest graph — a self-made island scores near zero and stays unpaid. An honest agent climbs the mesa once, cheaply, through real jobs; a farmer must buy 1,000 separate climbs, each one costing epochs of verified work.
